Project Name: Westover Hills Baptist Hospital - Postpartum Finish Out
Location Address: 3011 W Loop 1604 N, San Antonio, TX 78251
Type of Funds: This project is privately funded, on private land for private use.
Scope of Work: The project is intended to finish out the existing shell space at the second floor Postpartum Unit, expand the Nursery, and add 12 patient rooms with attached patient restrooms, 2 of which are fully ADA compliant. Work area is approximately 9,156 GSF
